subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: What should the permanent Feishu Drive info lookup contract be for files that are not on the first listed page?
rationale: The list half is fixed, but current maintainer discussion explicitly keeps info open because Feishu bot credentials do not have a browsable root and an automatic root-draining info lookup would make the wrong product promise.

options.title: Add folder-scoped info lookup
options.body: Add an optional concrete folder_token to info, paginate only within that folder, and document that root lookup remains limited for bot credentials.

options.title: Document list-first lookup
options.body: Keep info as a first-page/root helper and direct users to use paginated list to browse shared folders before requesting metadata.

options.title: Reject info pagination
options.body: Treat list continuation as the supported solution and close the remaining cross-page info behavior as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Add folder-scoped info lookup
recommendation.body: Add an optional concrete folder_token to info, paginate only within that folder, and document that root lookup remains limited for bot credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current-main list fix and posted the maintainer context that the remaining info behavior needs folder-aware contract proof.
